source_title: Recognised Universities/Colleges (official route; body not extractable in this check)
scope: Needed national name-level list of BCI-approved Centres of Legal Education / law colleges and recognised universities, with course and current approval status. PIB's 2024 parliamentary reply reports state-wise CLE approval counts over the prior ten years, not a current name-level roster.
scope_caveats: The BCI recognised-universities/colleges route resolved, but its body did not render/expose records through the browser check.
The PIB annexure is historical state-wise counts only (868 total over ten years); it cannot establish which individual CLE approvals are current.
Existing research/official_lists/bci/nlus.json covers Consortium/CLAT NLU candidates and UGC matching, not the national BCI approved CLE roster.
CLAT participation, university affiliation, or state admission eligibility alone must not be used as a proxy for BCI approval.
next_action: Obtain a current name-level BCI CLE/university roster and its effective academic session/validity and operative approval/withdrawal decisions from a working public source or BCI/Legal Education Committee.
acquisition_caveat: No college approvals were inferred and no partial state list was promoted to a national roster.
